newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa share futures softer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa share futures softer in quiet trade.

text.p: 0721 GMT - South African share futures open easier in quiet trade. Industrial contracts seen firming up on the back of a firmer Wall Street on Friday.

Dealers say small foreign buying coming through. Gold share futures eyeing this week's batch of gold quarterly results while bullion hovers at $342 an ounce. Underlying sentiment positive and cash market seen opening mixed to firm.
* June industrial contract is at 8,168/72 from 8,180 settlement, all-share is at 6,505/510 from 6,519 and the gold contract is at 875/85 from 878.
